autoISF_max.summary: Maximum ISF multiplier (1.0-3.0). Upper bound for AutoISF adjustments. Higher = allows stronger ISF increase (less insulin).

autoISF_min.summary: Minimum ISF multiplier (0.3-1.0). Lower bound for AutoISF adjustments. Lower = allows stronger ISF reduction (more insulin).
autoISF_min.effect_high: Allows stronger ISF reduction → more insulin → more aggressive
